links.outcome: Self-rated AI knowledge and desire for AI/LLM training among rheumatologists
links.effect: 88% rated their AI knowledge as low to intermediate; 84% would welcome dedicated training on LLMs; 73% did not use AI in daily practice.
links.quote: Eighty-eight percent of rheumatologists rated their AI knowledge as low to intermediate and 84% would welcome dedicated training on LLMs.

screen.reason: National cross-sectional survey examining the current adoption, barriers, and attitudes regarding AI and LLM use among German rheumatologists in clinical practice.
